'''First Contact''' is the 10th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 17 December 1997. The set consists of 130 cards.

The 130 cards of '''First Contact''' introduce a new affiliation, The Borg, enhanced personnel battling and other gameplay innovations, including Objective cards and new deck sizes (the 30/30 Rule).

This set is available in 9-card booster packs. There are 30 booster packs per box. Each booster pack contains 5 commons, 3 uncommons, and 1 rare.

[[Decipher]] also published a Rules Supplement / Cardlist that was inserted into every booster display box.

This set is noted for the following:
* First expansion to introduce the Time Travel mechanic and Time Locations
* First expansion to introduce Objectives
* First expansion to introduce the Borg Affiliation, assimilation, probing, and subcommand staffing
* First expansion to introduce the Enigma icon
* First expansion to introduce the Enterprise-E staffing icon
* First expansion to introduce the Delta Quadrant as a separate space line
* First expansion to introduce the First Contact property logo
* First expansion to introduce the OCD staffing icon
* First expansion to introduce an expansion icon on every card
* First expansion to introduce the Nemesis icon

==Additional Information==
*'''First Contact''' was printed by PBM, USA.
*Each rarity had its own print sheet.
*The Common print sheet had 2 sets of 40 cards, for a total of 80 cards (8x10 format).
*The Uncommon print sheet had 2 sets of 40 cards, for a total of 80 cards (8x10 format).
*The Rare print sheet had 2 sets of 50 cards, for a total of 100 cards (10x10 format).
